description:
Float {10} mana in your mana pool.
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, causing you to add {7}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Doubling Cube.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping Voltaic Key and Doubling Cube.
Repeat from step 2.
